title: Handle list shapes
summary: Haskell: Handle list shapes. Try the empty list.
introduction: Pattern matching selects steps based on a value shape. [] is an empty list; x:_ has a first item.

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
The nonempty pattern binds x to 8. The underscore ignores the remaining list.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Cover the empty-list case before assuming an item exists.
